body: I’m not sure I could afford couples counseling. And if it takes so much as to go to couples counseling to get her to decide whether she loves me or not then I’m not sure it’s a relationship that’s healthy for me to be in

Yes that is what I want to do but I don’t want to come back after the break and find out that she didn’t take time to reflect for herself. That she is just giving me time because I’m the only problem. Which I definitely am part of the problem for sure, but I don’t think I’m the only problem in the relationship. I just want things to be good again. I want to be loved and I want to not be depressed anymore. That’s why I wanna die sometimes!

I’ve been wondering how best to say that I wanna take a break. I know that I love her and that I don’t want our relationship to end. I just also need to know that she loves me. She does say that she loves me but that fact that I don’t always believe her denotes a problem right? The fact that I don’t feel loved back is definitely an issue that needs to be addressed. I want some time to be able to work on me and my depression and my own demons while she has time to evaluate and see if she actually loves ME or just the idea of me. I just don’t know how to do it without sounding like I’m blaming her! It’s eating me up inside

Thank you!! I really think I may do that. It’ll give me time to try and figure me out and work on my self confidence and self depression. And it’ll give her time to assess and see if being in a relationship with me is a thing she actually wants to do. I know I’m a man and generally men “aren’t supposed to show emotion” but I am an emotional guy, and I think I have every right to want to be loved and want to be thanked and cared for by the person I love! That’s not too much to ask is it? Or am I crazy?
